Use with caution / monitor.

The concurrent use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agents (NSAIDs), such as ibuprofen, and corticosteroids like prednisone increases the risk of gastrointestinal side effects [prednisone:drug_interactions:5]. Both drug classes can irritate the gastrointestinal tract, and combining them raises the likelihood of adverse events [prednisone:drug_interactions:5].
